name: toolradar
description: Recommend, compare, and get verified pricing for 8,600+ software tools.
long_description:
Toolradar gives Claude live access to a curated database of 8,600+ software tools: semantic search, budget-aware recommendations, side-by-side comparisons, real alternatives, verified pricing tiers, and aggregated G2/Capterra ratings. Data is refreshed continuously from vendors' own pricing pages.

Requires a free API key: create one at https://toolradar.com/dashboard/api-keys
